A few things you might wonder

A little clarity.

What is Pupwell?+

Pupwell is a habit and wellbeing app with a puppy companion. It brings daily goals, focus, journaling, breathing breaks and optional connection into one gentle routine.

When can I download it?+

We're getting Pupwell ready for iPhone. The official App Store link will appear here when it's available.

Can I use Pupwell for free?+

Your puppy and core personal routine are free. Optional Pupwell Plus adds connected Friends features and voice journals up to 30 minutes. Final pricing and any eligible trial are shown in the app before purchase.

Can I use it with my partner or a friend?+

Yes. With Plus, both people can connect privately using an invite code. Your puppies meet by the campfire, where you can leave notes and choose which goals to share. Both people need their own Plus membership.

Are my journal and recordings private?+

Written journals and voice recordings stay on your device. They aren't automatically shared with your connected person or uploaded to a Pupwell cloud backup. You decide what to export or share.
